name: clearly
description: Clearly — your company brain over MCP, for Claude Code and any MCP agent.

plugins.name: clearly
plugins.description: Connect your Clearly workspace as a company brain: search org context (prompts, docs, decisions, facts), write decisions back so they compound, schedule your own follow-ups, and inherit the team's skills. Bundles the pre-configured MCP server plus two skills — clearly-init (setup) and clearly-workflows (usage).
